producer_report.summary:
I revised docs/design/parallel-jobs.md for review 2's N1-N6, with N1 first, and added a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased]. Only those two files are modified, and the review file is untouched. I checked scope with `git status --short` and checked line widths and the banned words with Grep. I did not run fmt, clippy or test, since only Markdown changed.

The edits to the design:
- **N1:** Section 7 point 2 and section 8 point 2 now keep local landing inside each child, ordered by the repository lock. The launcher queue and the "rebuild before the next landing check" claim are gone. `land --pr` is a second phase, run per landed job by the launcher (with a `--pr` flag) or by the user. A job's result is `pr-open` until the merge is seen.
- **N2:** Section 9 says rules 1 and 2 take effect with the build, and rule 3 is the working rule until then.
- **N3:** Children run with a child-only flag, `--child-report`, and print a `result` field (`refused`, `locked`, `error` or `reread`), so the launcher never parses message text. The `--json` text now gives the `reread` fields and says that object has no `state`.
- **N4:** Section 6.3 says an open pull request gives exit 2 in a multi-job run, and that this differs on purpose from `athena land --pr` run alone, which returns 0.
- **N5:** For two or more change jobs, including `--all`, the launcher warns that stale jobs still cost their full budgets. It asks for confirmation on a terminal and needs `--yes` otherwise.
- **N6:** The declared paths are named as `Reading.deliverables`. A job with no reading yet is not serialized, and the landing check decides.

I also closed question 9 using review 2's evidence, added an N1-N6 mapping table, and added review 2's `reap()` concurrency check as an open build item. The prose I added or re-wrapped is at 110 columns or fewer, including the kill-switch paragraph in section 4.2.

In the CHANGELOG, I reworded the existing review-2 bullet, which said "The design itself is not edited", so it stays accurate. The new bullet describes this revision."

open_issues: The names `--child-report`, `--pr` and `--yes` are proposals and are marked "name not fixed" in the design.
With merge_via_rest off, a later job's pull request carries earlier unmerged local commits. I recorded this under question 8; it is not resolved.
`registry().reap()` runs in every `go`, so several children will call it at once. Review 2 did not check whether that is safe, and I left it as a build-job check.
I did not run cargo fmt, clippy or test, since no Rust files changed.
mistakes: An early Edit call used a guessed old_string and failed. A later one also failed, again because I had guessed the text. Neither changed the file.
My first pass wrapped some edited paragraphs at 111-113 columns. I re-wrapped them all to 110 or fewer.
learnings: The doc's prose wraps at about 110 columns. A few older lines reach 112 or 113 characters, and table rows are unwrapped.

The first CHANGELOG bullet, "The design itself is not edited", would have been false once this revision landed. It now says the review does not edit the design and that the next entry records the revision.
Section 13 of the design still says CHANGELOG entries for the build belong to the docs job. I left it, because this entry records a design revision, not the build.
desires: A markdown line-width linter, to confirm the 110-column width instead of inferring it.
